name: Douglas County, CO
findings: Douglas County has 1,179 nonprofit organizations. 501 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 400 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Douglas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 21 youth organizations here list public events, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.
